title: Four inputs set the mix
objectives: Name the four inputs that set the mix.
Explain why a market view is not one of them.
body_md:
The mix comes from the client, not from a market view. Four inputs decide it.

| Input | What it means | How to find out |
|---|---|---|
| Time horizon | When the money is needed | Ask the goal date for each pot of money |
| Risk capacity | How much loss the client can afford financially | Income stability, dependants, emergency fund, loans, other assets |
| Risk tolerance | How much loss the client can live with emotionally | Risk-profile questionnaire, past behaviour in falls |
| Goal type | Must-have or nice-to-have | Is the amount or the date flexible? |

## Why not a market view

A mix built on a forecast has to be changed when the forecast changes, and the client is then exposed to our timing. The four inputs above are stable, personal and documented. They produce a mix the client can hold when the forecast is wrong, which it will be.

## The questions that get you there

"What is this money for, and when will you need it?" "How stable is your income? Who depends on it?" "Do you have six months of expenses set aside? Any loans?" "What did you do during the last big fall?"
example: A client wants more equity because "the market is going up". The four inputs show a three-year goal and an emergency fund of one month, so the mix stays conservative and the market view is not used.
say: The mix comes from your goal, your horizon and your comfort with losses, not from my market view.
What is this money for, and when will you need it?
never: Let's go heavy on equity while the market is strong.
I'm confident about the next year, so we'll adjust the mix.

check.q: Which is NOT one of the four inputs that set the mix?
check.why: The mix comes from the client, not from a market view.

check.q: How do you measure risk capacity?
o: From income stability, dependants, the emergency fund, loans and other assets
check.why: Capacity is financial: income stability, dependants, buffer, loans and other assets. Tolerance is emotional.

check.q: Why is a market view a poor basis for a mix?
o: Because it has to be changed when the forecast changes, exposing the client to our timing
check.why: A forecast-led mix is unstable. Goals, horizon and risk profile are stable, personal and documented.
